effects.name: Dragonhide Belt
effects.description: +2 bonus to the saving throw DCs of your ki features.

description.value:
Wondrous Item, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Monk)

This finely detailed belt is made of dragonhide. While wearing it, you gain a +2 bonus to the saving throw DCs of your ki features.

In addition, you can use an action to regain ki points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die. You can't use this action again until the next dawn.

Foundry Note

The +2 DC bonus is applied via system.bonuses.spell.dc, which increases all ability-based save DCs (including ki). The Regain Focus activity rolls the Martial Arts die (@scale.monk.die) and restores that many Focus Points on the Monk's Focus feature. Requires the 2024 Monk class with the Monk's Focus feature (identifier: monks-focus).

description.chatFlavor: Roll your Martial Arts die and regain that many ki points.
